name: baton
description: Work board for Claude Code: auto handoff + compaction before the prompt cache expires, lane overview, layered memory / 工作看板：快取將過期時自動交接並壓縮、lane 一覽、分層記憶

language.title: Language / 語言
language.description: Board, handoff instructions and briefings. auto: Claude Code's language setting, else LANG / 看板、交接指示與說明的語言。auto：依 Claude Code 的 language 設定，沒設則看 LANG

memory_dir.title: Memory folder / 記憶資料夾
memory_dir.description: Folder the Memory tab reads. Supports {config} (~/.claude), {project} (project slug), {root} (project root), ~; relative to the project root / 記憶分頁讀取的資料夾。可用 {config}、{project}、{root}、~；相對路徑以專案根目錄為準

handoff_path.title: Handoff document / 交接文件
handoff_path.description: File auto-handoff writes and the Progress tab shows. Same placeholders as above; override per project in {config}/projects/{project}/baton.json / 自動交接寫入、進度分頁顯示的檔案。可用同上的代號；個別專案可用 {config}/projects/{project}/baton.json 覆寫

brief_on_start.title: Brief on start / 自動接續交接文件
brief_on_start.description: Attach the handoff mechanism and document to the first prompt of a new session or after compaction / 新 session 或壓縮後的第一個 prompt，自動附上交接機制說明與交接文件

launcher_button.title: Launcher button / 輸入框上方的看板按鈕
launcher_button.description: Show a board button above the prompt box while the board is closed / 看板關著時，在輸入框上方顯示一顆按鈕，點了打開看板

cache_ttl.title: Prompt cache TTL / 提示快取時效
cache_ttl.description: Basis for the countdown; no auto-handoff at 5m. The value reported on model switch wins / 倒數依據；5m 時不自動交接。切換模型時以引擎告知的值為準

away_hours.title: Away cutoff (hours) / 離開多久後不再自動交接（小時）
away_hours.description: Skip auto-handoff when the last input is older than this / 最後一次輸入超過這麼久，快取到期前就不再自動交接
